blocks.name: immediate_generator
blocks.responsibility: Generate sign-extended I-, S-, B-, and J-type immediates, and the zero-extended U-type immediate from the instruction word.
blocks.design_rationale: Centralizes immediate bit mapping and sign extension, making branch, jump, load/store, and ALU-immediate behavior independently verifiable.

blocks.name: register_file
blocks.responsibility: Provide 32 32-bit integer registers with two asynchronous read ports, one rising-edge write port, asynchronous active-high reset, and hardwired-zero x0.
blocks.design_rationale: Isolates architectural state and asynchronous operand reads, keeping the single-cycle datapath simple and register behavior easy to test.

blocks.name: alu
blocks.responsibility: Perform RV32I arithmetic, logic, shifts, and signed and unsigned comparisons selected by an operation control input.
blocks.design_rationale: Keeps datapath operations and comparison semantics in one combinational block, supporting focused verification and avoiding unnecessary pipeline state.

blocks.name: decoder
blocks.responsibility: Decode RV32IM instruction fields into the existing RV32I controls and identify valid RV32M OP instructions for the CPU's M-result path.
blocks.design_rationale: The decoder must not classify valid M instructions as unsupported, or the CPU would suppress their register writes. A dedicated enable cleanly identifies the M path; funct3 is already available from instr for selecting the particular operation.

blocks.name: muldiv
blocks.responsibility: Compute the selected RV32M result from two 32-bit operands and funct3. Implement low and high product results with the required signedness, truncation-toward-zero signed division and remainder, division-by-zero results, and the signed division overflow case.
blocks.design_rationale: Keeping M execution separate isolates its arithmetic and special cases from the existing RV32I ALU. The block is combinational so its result is available for the same rising edge that completes the instruction. Division-by-zero and signed-overflow cases must be handled before invoking division operators.

blocks.name: cpu
blocks.responsibility: Implement the RV32IM single-cycle top level: maintain the PC, instantiate the immediate generator, register file, ALU, decoder, and multiply/divide unit, select branch and jump targets, perform load extraction and extension, and drive the instruction and data buses exactly as specified.
blocks.design_rationale: The CPU is the integration point for the new M control and result path. M instructions use the ordinary register read and writeback timing, do not access memory or alter PC selection, and must complete in one cycle. Retaining the fixed public interface and established RV32I datapath preserves the prior contract.

notes: Use only ieee.std_logic_1164 and ieee.numeric_std. The decoder's wb_select encodings should distinguish ALU result, load data, PC+4, and U-immediate; AUIPC uses PC as the ALU first operand. Branch conditions use funct3 together with the ALU comparison outputs. Stores drive the unshifted rs2 value and select byte, halfword, or word width; loads select and extend the addressed subword from the asynchronously supplied aligned word.
